import numpy as np
import tslearn.metrics

# Compute DTW distance of a series to itself
dist_self = tslearn.metrics.dtw(s1, s1)
assert np.isclose(dist_self, 0.0), f"DTW distance to self must be 0.0, got {dist_self}"

# Compute unconstrained DTW distance between s1 and s2
dist_s1_s2 = tslearn.metrics.dtw(s1, s2)

# Compute DTW distance with Sakoe-Chiba band constraint
dist_constrained = tslearn.metrics.dtw(s1, s2, global_constraint="sakoe_chiba", sakoe_chiba_radius=2)

# Constraining the warping path can only increase (or maintain) the minimum distance
assert dist_constrained >= dist_s1_s2 - 1e-9, "Constrained DTW distance cannot be less than unconstrained"

print(f"__CHECK__ dtw {dist_self:.1f} {dist_s1_s2:.4f} {dist_constrained:.4f}")
